sessions.title: AC Companion Server + Script Execution Bridge
sessions.intent: Build the Automation Center companion server that bridges PRISM MCP commands to hyperMILL script execution. This server listens for script execution requests from PRISM, forwards them to hyperMILL's Automation Center API, and returns results. Unlike Fusion 360's dead-end API, hyperMILL's AC provides full programmatic control.

units.title: Build HyperMillACCompanionServer — script execution bridge
units.description: Create HyperMillACCompanionServer that: (1) listens on configurable port for PRISM requests, (2) accepts AC Python scripts from HyperMillCodeGeneratorEngine, (3) executes scripts via hyperMILL Automation Center API, (4) returns execution results (success/failure, output, errors). Includes connection health check, retry logic (3 attempts with exponential backoff), and timeout handling (30s default, configurable).
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: HyperMillACCompanionServer.ts listens on configurable port
Accepts and executes AC Python scripts
Connection health check with retry logic (3 attempts, exponential backoff)
Timeout handling (30s default, configurable)
cam:hypermill_ac_execute action registered
4 unit tests: script execution, health check, retry logic, timeout

units.title: Build 10 AC Python script templates for hyperMILL execution
units.description: Create 10 AC Python script templates (Agent 7 design): AC-01 (job setup), AC-02 (tool load from TDB), AC-03 (roughing cycle), AC-04 (finishing cycle), AC-05 (5-axis setup), AC-06 (NC generation), AC-07 (batch program), AC-08 (simulation launch), AC-09 (tool path export), AC-10 (project save/backup). Each template is parameterized — HyperMillCodeGeneratorEngine fills in the values from PRISM context.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: 10 AC Python script templates created
Templates are parameterized (not hardcoded values)
HyperMillCodeGeneratorEngine can fill templates from PRISM context
AC-07 (batch program) handles multi-operation sequences
3 unit tests: template rendering, parameter substitution, batch sequence

units.title: Build hypermill-ac-connection-health hook + port configuration fix
units.description: Build hypermill-ac-connection-health hook that checks AC companion server reachability before any AC execution action. Fix port mismatch issue (Agent 18: AC default port vs PRISM expected port). Create configuration system that allows port, host, and timeout to be set per shop floor installation. Wire cam:hypermill_ac_status action for monitoring.

sessions.title: PPP File Writer + Job Status Monitoring
knowledge: Agent 18 report (PPP output never leaves memory)
sessions.intent: Build the PPP file writer so that post-processed NC output actually reaches the filesystem (Agent 18: PPP output never leaves memory). Add job status monitoring for long-running AC operations (nightSHIFT batch processing).

units.title: Build PPP file writer + hyperMILL project folder integration
units.description: Create HyperMillPPPFileWriter that writes post-processed NC output from PostProcessorPipelineEngine to the filesystem in hyperMILL's expected project folder structure. Handles: NC file naming convention (per controller dialect), sub-program splitting, setup sheet companion file, and atomic write (no partial files on failure). Wire to hyperMILL project folder structure detection.
units.four_loop: BUILD → SCRUTINIZE → GAP FILL → TIE UP
exit_criteria: PPP output written to filesystem (not just memory)
NC file naming follows hyperMILL convention per controller
Sub-program splitting handled for controllers that require it
Atomic write prevents partial files on failure
cam:hypermill_ppp_write action registered
3 unit tests: file write, naming convention, atomic write on failure

units.title: Build job status monitoring for AC + nightSHIFT batch operations
units.description: Create HyperMillJobMonitor that tracks long-running AC operations: nightSHIFT batch calculate, batch simulate, batch post-process. Polls AC companion server for job progress (% complete, current operation, estimated time remaining). Emits events for: job start, progress update (every 10%), job complete, job error. Wire cam:hypermill_job_status action.

Events emitted: start, progress (10% intervals), complete, error

3 unit tests: job tracking, progress events, error handling
